body:
Maya (Growth): FYI, noticed a spike in leads not getting assigned in the last hour — several show owner=null after enrichment. SLAs start failing at 20-30m.

Sam (RevOps): ugh, are these all from the webinar push or across forms?

Maya (Growth): mixed sources; webinar + main site. sample ids 773001, 773045, 773102.

Leo (Eng): quick glance at logs — enrichment service queue is spiking. Some webhooks are returning 504s. current HS workflow waits 5s for enrichment result before running assigner.

Olivia (Sales Ops): if owner is null they don't route to SDR queue. We need a safe fallback until this is stable. Can we have a BDR_rotation default after X retries?

Sam (RevOps): plan candidate: 1) Eng: increase enrichment webhook timeout to 18s + 2 retries (canary 10% traffic). 2) Sales Ops: HubSpot fallback owner after 2 failed enrichment attempts -> BDR rotation. 3) RevOps: bulk-assign queued leads older than 15m. 4) Growth: notify SDRs and update handoff doc.

Raj (Support): query to find affected leads:
```
SELECT id, source, created_at, owner_id, enrichment_errors
FROM hubspot_leads
WHERE owner_id IS NULL
  AND created_at > now() - interval '3 hours';
```
I'll run and export.

hubspot-bot: Alert: "Enrichment webhook failures" — 18 errors in 10m. Suspected service timeout.

Leo (Eng): deploying canary now: config `enrichment.timeout_ms=18000`, `enrichment.max_retries=2` with exponential jitter. Observability: added histogram on response times.

Olivia (Sales Ops): added HS workflow node: if enrichment_status != 'complete' after 2 retries -> assign owner = BDR_rotation (tz-aware). adding property `fallback_assigned=true` for auditing.

Maya (Growth): good. I'll update the handoff playbook with the bulk-assign script and the alert runbook. Also adding a dashboard note for SLA impact.

Sam (RevOps): executing bulk-assign now for leads >15m; will post counts and owner distributions when done.

Leo (Eng): canary looks stable after 5m, rolling to 50% then full in 20m unless errors spike.

Maya (Growth): please ping #sdr-team when bulk-assign completes. want to avoid duplicate outreach.

Sam (RevOps): done — bulk-assign completed: 42 leads reassigned (BDR_rotation=28, regional SDRs=14). pushed notification to SDR channel.

Olivia (Sales Ops): will verify routing and follow-ups. Also adding an automated check: if owner=null after 10m alert ops.

Maya (Growth): thanks all. postmortem doc placeholder: will collect timelines and next steps after we confirm stability. :rocket:
